note: Every creative value in this file is an analytical assumption defined by the project, not a claim that it performs better. Values are generic and contain no brand names.

seasons.note: Assumption: generic seasonal directions chosen by the project; not tested for performance.

spring.scene: city park or tree-lined street with early greenery

summer.scene: coastal promenade or open rooftop at the end of the day
summer.lighting: warm evening sunlight, long soft shadows

autumn.scene: street or park with fallen leaves in warm tones
autumn.lighting: low golden-hour sunlight, warm color temperature

winter.scene: cold urban street or snowy outdoor setting
winter.lighting: cool overcast daylight with soft contrast

department_model.note: Business rule: the department is a descriptive label from the data; scene and styling stay identical across departments and only the model differs. Avoid stereotypes in pose, setting, styling and wording. Assumption: the model wording below.

formats.note: Project-defined working sizes, not official platform specifications. Assumption: chosen as common working sizes for the Stage 6 automation.

restrictions.note: Business rules / decisions defined by the project for every generated output.
all_modes: human review is required before any output is considered valid
demo_mode: no brand names or logos in generated text or imagery
label the output as illustrative: not a TheLook product
the reference image must be one the project owner has the right to use; its license is verified in Stage 6
production_mode: a reference image of the real product is required
the product is never altered or invented: shape, color, details and logo stay as in the reference image
